notes: Sourced from Allen & Heath's official "DX168 Getting Started Guide" (AP11129 Issue 2, © Allen & Heath 2018) — a manufacturer-authored document also linked from support.allen-heath.com; the manufacturer's own allen-heath.com/support.allen-heath.com pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so the identical guide was retrieved from a third-party PDF mirror (warehousesound.com) and cross-checked for port counts against B&H Photo's product listing. DX168 is primarily a portable/floor stage box; the 4U rack size applies only when using the optional AB1608-RK19 19" rack-mount kit (not required for normal operation). "DX A" and "DX B" are Neutrik EtherCon (locking RJ45) ports carrying Allen & Heath's proprietary "DX Link" protocol (audio + preamp control + system status) over Cat5e/Cat6 STP, max 100m; DX B can be switched between Cascade (daisy-chain to a second DX168/DX164-W) and Redundant (dual-cable link to compatible mixer hardware) modes. No Ethernet link-speed (e.g. 1G) is published for DX Link, so "grade" is omitted on these ports rather than inferred. The 16 mic/line inputs and 8 line outputs are not individually numbered/labeled in the source text (front panel diagram callouts only say "Input sockets" / "Output sockets"); numbering 1-16 and 1-8 here follows the physical layout and industry-standard convention for this device, not an explicit per-socket label in the text.

ports.name: DX A
ports.note: Neutrik EtherCon (locking RJ45). Proprietary DX Link connection to mixer (dLive/SQ/Avantis) carrying audio, preamp control, and status data over Cat5e/6 STP, max 100m. No published Ethernet link-speed rating, so grade is omitted.

ports.name: DX B
ports.note: Neutrik EtherCon (locking RJ45). Switchable: Redundant mode (second cable to compatible mixer hardware) or Cascade mode (daisy-chain a second DX168/DX164-W). No published Ethernet link-speed rating, so grade is omitted.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC inlet with fuse, universal PSU accepting 100-240V AC 50/60Hz, 20W max consumption.
